entries.title: I Samuel 18:1
segments: Real excellence of character forms the surest basis for ardent and durable friendship, and those who rightly cultivate it on earth may hope to enjoy it for ever in heaven.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:5
segments: The presence and favor of God are the grand source of all true wisdom, and the surest guarantee of durable success.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:6
segments: Tabrets; or timbrels; a sort of small drum.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:8
segments: An envious disposition tends to torment him who indulges it, and all who feel its influence.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:9
segments: Saul eyed David; he watched him with jealous feelings.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:10
segments:
Prophesied; under the influence of the evil spirit, the king imitated the manner of speaking that belonged to the true prophets when they were under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. 
 
  A javelin; a light spear pointed with metal.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:11
segments: There is no wickedness so great but the human heart, unrestrained by divine grace, may commit it.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:15
segments: Rulers often regard their own glory more than the public good, and seek to destroy those whom the people delight to honor.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:17
segments: What men will not do directly, they often attempt to do indirectly, and thus try to cast the responsibility of their evil actions on others.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:18
segments: What is my life; what is my condition of life?  or, as we say, What are my circumstances?  He imitates that they are too humble to allow him to think of such an alliance.  Compare

entries.title: I Samuel 18:25
segments: Dowry; among the Hebrews, and generally, in the East, a compensation or present made by the bridegroom to the father of the bride.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:26
segments: The days; previous to the time appointed for his marriage.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:29
segments: The more one is favored in the course of divine Providence, the more will envious men hate him.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:30
segments: Went forth; to fight with Israel.
